title: Build a loop with an exact boundary
prompt: For a non-negative int n small enough to avoid sum overflow, count and sum the odd integers from1 through n that are at least5. Give the branch condition and loop bounds. Trace n=9, then check n=0 and n=4.

fields.label: Boolean condition and inclusive loop range

rubric: Includes n itself when it qualifies, using a loop with i≤n under the stated small-input bound.
Initializes count and sum to0 and increments them only for qualifying values.
reference: One solution loops i from1 through n and enters the branch when i % 2 != 0 && i >= 5. Increment count and add i to sum within that branch.
For n=9, qualifying values are5,7,9: count3 and sum21. For n=0 or n=4, both results remain0.
Equivalent while or for loops are valid. A switch can classify finite cases but is not a replacement for the general numeric condition. No automated score is assigned to the written algorithm.
